alt: 學生在會議中各自指向不同的校園花園設計圖，老師協助討論，大家仍未取得共識。
scene_prompt: Modern student council meeting. Five students offer different reasonable ideas for a school garden layout, each pointing to a different sketch on a board; the teacher facilitates but the group has not reached agreement, faces thoughtful and uncertain. Many opinions, no unified conclusion. Natural anatomy, plausible hands, grounded chairs/table and coherent perspective.
style_prompt: Children's picture book, landscape 3:2, hand-drawn graphite pencil lines, soft watercolor, colored-pencil grain, warm ivory textured paper; no text or logos.
